definitions.explanation: A distinctive set of clothes worn by members of the same organization, school, or workplace.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{制服|せいふく}を{着|き}る。
{制服|せいふく}は{毎日|まいにち}{洗濯|せんたく}している。
examples.english: I wash my uniform every day.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{制服|せいふく}がない。

notes:
{制服|せいふく} combines {制|せい} (regulation) + {服|ふく} (clothes).

TYPES OF UNIFORMS:
- {学校|がっこう}{制服|せいふく} (school uniform)
- {会社|かいしゃ}の{制服|せいふく} (company uniform)
- {警察|けいさつ}の{制服|せいふく} (police uniform)
- {軍服|ぐんぷく} (military uniform)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {制服|せいふく}を{着|き}る (to wear a uniform)
- {制服|せいふく}に{着替|きが}える (to change into uniform)
- {制服|せいふく}{姿|すがた} (in uniform)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese school uniforms are an iconic part of student life. Most junior high and high schools require uniforms, and they have become a significant aspect of Japanese pop culture.
